title: The first edit of a file kind brings its standards into the session
body:
Source: .krn/runs/brain-research/north-star.md missing item 1, moment "before editing a file kind/stack"
Why: rules shown once at session start sink under later context (context rot, Lost in the Middle); the records for a file kind should arrive when the session first edits that kind of file.
Outcome: a PreToolUse hook on Edit|Write|MultiEdit, the first time in a session that a scope (stack or path pattern) is edited, adds the matching records not yet shown this session as additional context (at most 150 tokens, deduplicated per session, holdout excluded, exposure moment "edit"); `krn adopt` installs it in every repository and KRN runs the same hook.
Files: src/hook/ (new edit-standards.ts), src/cli/hook.ts, src/adopt/adopt.ts, .claude/settings.json, test/hook/
Proof: hook test on a verbatim PreToolUse payload capture: first PHP edit injects the PHP-scoped record, the second does not; an outside php row logs edit exposures > 0 and drains 0.
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 3 rows
